description: Source code for a video decoder class handling MPEG4 and H263 codecs, including initialization, buffer management, resolution handling, and decoding frames, with a fuzzing entry point.

classes.name: Codec
classes.description: A class for initializing, decoding, and managing buffers for MPEG4/H263 video streams.

methods.name: allocOutputBuffer
methods.description: Allocates output buffers for decoded frames.

methods.name: handleResolutionChange
methods.description: Checks and updates resolution if it has changed.

methods.name: decodeFrames
methods.description: Decodes input data into video frames, handling headers and resolution changes.

methods.name: deInitDecoder
methods.description: Cleans up and deinitializes the decoder.
